notes: Recorded 11 Window 1 programmes (8 universities) and 31 Window 2 programmes (16 universities) = 42 programme rows at master level, which is the full content of both official lists. Counting the two IHS specialisations and the two GraSPP streams separately gives 44, the figure the World Bank gives for its programmes.
Columbia University SIPA appears in both windows with different programmes; the name Master of Public Policy appears for several universities and is listed once per university.
Both pages state no teaching language or duration for the programmes; these are on each programme's own website.
